name: Cascara Sagrada
headline: Cascara Sagrada
description: A gentle laxative based on cascara sagrada (Rhamnus purshiana). It supports intestinal motility and a normal, soft stool while helping reduce irritation of the intestinal lining.
howToUse: Adults – 1 tablet in the evening with food.

manufacturing.expiration: 2 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C.
